{{MissingInfo|1|java}} [[File:Jack Sinnoh.png|250px|thumb|Jack]] '''Jack''' is a recurring character in {{aniseries|DP}}. He has appeared in eight episodes: ''[[DP029|The Champ Twins!]]'', ''[[DP033|All Dressed up With Somewhere to Go!]]'', ''[[DP036|A Secret Sphere of Influence]]'', ''[[DP040|Top-Down Training]]'', ''[[DP044|Mass Hip-Po-Sis!]]'', ''[[DP075|Our Cup Runneth Over!]]'', ''[[DP118|Pursuing a Lofty Goal!]]'', and ''[[DP135|Beating the Bustle and Hustle!]]''. He was not given a name in the Japanese version. He is a member of {{si|Rhonda}}'s ''[[Sinnoh Now]]'' crew and accompanies her to various assignments. He handles the microphone boom and often accidentally drops the boom onto Rhonda's head, which has become a running gag within the series. However, in ''Pursuing a Lofty Goal!'', Jack fell asleep, which led him to lose his grip on the boom mike. In ''Beating the Bustle and Hustle!'', he dropped it on [[Jessie]]'s head, and Rhonda threatened to fire him.
